exposure: Buprenorphine treatment for opioid use disorder
Two groups: women treated with methadone and women treated with buprenorphine
Methadone treatment for opioid use disorder
cohort: Women with opioid use disorders who underwent cesarean section between 2006 and 2014
finding: There were no significant differences in post-cesarean section opioid analgesic requirements, postoperative complications, or length of hospital stay between women treated with methadone and those treated with buprenorphine for opioid use disorder.
mod_finding: Both buprenorphine and methadone treatment groups had similar opioid requirements before, during, and after cesarean section.
